critic_note: Key is tiny and tangled on the shoulder, person sits inside house like a prisoner. Draw a big key held up in one clear hand, house smaller behind, no overlap.
Child's torso/head overlap and adult head sinks into the body (no neck, hair merged). Draw dad with full face and hair, child sitting on his shoulders with both heads clearly separate.
Reads as 'person holding a letter/certificate', not pride. Make a big medal/ribbon on the chest, chin up, chest out, no paper.
Road ending abruptly beside an arrow stone; reads as a slide. Draw a straight road going into distance with a milestone/signpost reading a number, on the road edge.
Arm is a flat detached stripe, hand-brick floating; founder concept weak. Attach a proper arm, place brick onto a foundation row with a trowel, add hard hat for builder/founder.
He holds a bat and wears no cap; reads as 'cricket player', not captain. Add captain's cap with badge and a C armband or whistle; drop the bat.
This is an orange/mandarin; word is a ripe apple. Make it red with a small apple dimple, stem and one leaf, gloss highlight.
